pixel-label.purpose: Repeated section headings and primary action labels.

body.purpose: Instructions, controls, table values, units, and canvas labels.

shadows.name: moving-garment
shadows.purpose: Canvas-only shadow while a garment moves during rearrangement.

motion.name: low-time
motion.purpose: Low-time statistic. Disabled by CSS reduced-motion preference.

extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are generated OKLCH preview strips, not additional shipped palette tokens. The 600px threshold measures canvas width, not viewport width. Queue SVG stands in for the source canvas preview using the same sleeve polygon.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Lime pixel action for replay and the review countdown.

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Neutral beveled control for rotation, undo, and shelf completion.

components.name: Size control
components.description: Order-size stepper with a lime size name and tabular count.
components.css: .ds-size{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:var(--panel,#242424);border:2px solid var(--line,#3a3a3a);padding:3px;font:400 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Mono",monospace;color:var(--text,#f2f2ee)}.ds-size b{width:26px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--lime,#e9fb5a)}.ds-size span{min-width:18px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-size button{width:28px;height:30px;border:2px solid;border-color:#5e5e5e #171717 #171717 #5e5e5e;background:var(--panel-2,#2c2c2c);color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:16px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}.ds-size button:hover{background:#393939}.ds-size button:active:not(:disabled){border-color:#141414 #5e5e5e #5e5e5e #141414}.ds-size button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--lime,#e9fb5a);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-size button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat square panel with a purple pixel section heading.
components.html:
Siguiente

Cantidad por pieza y talla, incluida la pieza en la mano.
components.css: .ds-card{background:var(--panel,#242424);color:var(--text,#f2f2ee);border:2px solid var(--line,#3a3a3a);padding:16px;border-radius:0;font:400 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Mono",monospace}.ds-card h2{margin:0 0 16px;font:400 11px/1.7 "Press Start 2P",monospace;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple,#c6b3e4)}.ds-card p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#a3a39c);font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}

components.name: Queue tile
components.description: A grouped piece and size, with remaining quantity and explicit selection. The inline SVG reproduces the sleeve polygon used by the canvas preview.

components.name: Statistic
components.description: Inset metric with a muted monospace label, lime pixel value, and smaller units.
components.css: .ds-stat{background:var(--bg,#1c1c1c);padding:12px 10px;border-radius:0;font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace}.ds-k{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#a3a39c);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-v{font:400 20px/1.6 "Press Start 2P",monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-top:6px;color:var(--lime,#e9fb5a)}.ds-v small{font:400 12px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace;color:var(--muted,#a3a39c);margin-left:4px}.ds-v.ds-low{color:var(--orange,#ff5a00);animation:ds-blink 1s steps(2,start) infinite}@keyframes ds-blink{50%{opacity:.55}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-v.ds-low{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
This records the user's approved retro refinement of the existing TelaTetris interface. Pixel headings, score numbers, and square beveled controls provide the arcade reference. The Labs palette and existing game composition remain the visual foundation.

Garment shapes retain their actual outlines. The cloth roll, ruler, cutting lines, and piece quantities make the arrangement readable throughout play and comparison. Retro styling belongs to the interface around those measurements.
keyCharacteristics: Pixel display text paired with monospace instructions and measurements.
Lime, orange, and purple on layered charcoal backgrounds.
Square panels, arcade bevels, and visible selection borders.
One cloth roll retained across play, rearrangement, and results.

rules.name: The Same Piece Color Rule
rules.body: Keep each garment type's fill consistent between its queue preview and the board. Orange may override the fill to show an invalid placement.

rules.name: The Pixel Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use the pixel family for headings, primary actions, counts, and scores. Keep instructions, garment names, table values, units, and canvas measurements in IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Arcade Bevel Rule
rules.body: Use opposing light and dark borders for board and control depth; reverse the control bevel on press.

dos: **Do** keep Labs colors consistent across interface and garment previews.
**Do** pair pixel headings and scores with monospace explanations and measurements.
**Do** retain square corners, directional bevels, lime keyboard focus, and visible queue selection.
**Do** preserve readable cut labels on separate rows when the canvas is narrow.
donts: **Don't** replace garment outlines with Tetris blocks to communicate the retro style.
**Don't** expose the validator or its check results in the interface; validation remains internal.
**Don't** change the existing composition or gameplay as part of a styling extension.
